answer: Entry to the grove requires locking 60 POA in an ivory quartz-vault for 21 days; the vault releases only after three peer-verified tasks complete. A sybil operator seeding 800 fake agents must lock 800 x 60 = 48,000 POA and run each through three real tasks separately. Vaults cannot be shared across identities, so the cost scales directly with the number of clones.
